comment_regular: [Verified] Selects and publishes the renderer shader-package version at RendererGlobalState+0xAF from adapter/version inputs and vendor prefix. The third argument is bForce1XShaders; when true and a shader version is available, the function forces package version 1. Argument maxPS20Instructions is the same value logged as maxPS20inst; ATI/NVIDIA paths choose versions 3–6 and set +0xC when it exceeds 0xFF. Fallback branches choose version 0/1 and clear HDR mode at +0x1D7. [Verified] +0xC gates Lighting30 definition 0x1A; [Probable] it represents shader-feature capability. This native selector emits versions 0–6 only; [Unknown] the writer/source of version 7, which the package-index switch handles, has not yet been identified.
